quickSummary: CCl₄ is symmetrical tetrahedral with μ=0. Chloroform (CHCl₃) autoxidizes in air/light to toxic Phosgene (COCl₂); prevented by dark amber bottles + 1% ethanol (converts COCl₂ to diethyl carbonate). Iodoform test (I₂/NaOH) yields yellow CHI₃ ppt for methyl ketones (CH₃CO-) and secondary methyl carbinols (CH₃CH(OH)-). Ethanol, acetaldehyde, acetone, propan-2-ol are positive; methanol, propan-1-ol, benzophenone are negative.
summary: Master polyhalogen chemistry, phosgene toxicity prevention, and diagnostic Iodoform test mechanics.

summaryBox.title: Chloroform & Phosgene Chemistry
summaryBox.takeaway: 2CHCl₃ + O₂ ──(hν)──► 2COCl₂ (Phosgene) + 2HCl. 1% ethanol converts toxic COCl₂ to non-toxic Diethyl Carbonate.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
SAFE STORAGE OF CHLOROFORM
                        
   1. Stored in **dark, amber-colored glass bottles** filled to the brim (eliminating air/light).
   2. $1\%$ ethanol ($\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{OH}$) is added. Ethanol converts any trace phosgene formed into
      non-toxic **Diethyl Carbonate**:
      $$\text{COCl}_2 + 2\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{OH} \longrightarrow \mathbf{(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{O})_2\text{C=O} \text{ (Diethyl Carbonate)}} + 2\text{HCl}$$
conceptBreakdown.content:
- **Carbon Tetrachloride ($\text{CCl}_4$)**: Symmetrical regular tetrahedron ($sp^3$), four bond dipoles cancel out completely ($\mu_{\text{net}} = 0$). Formerly used as fire extinguisher (*Pyrene*).
- **Chloroform ($\text{CHCl}_3$)**: Autoxidizes in light/air to poisonous Phosgene gas ($\text{COCl}_2$).

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
IODOFORM REACTION SCHEME
                           
   $\text{CH}_3\text{-CO-R} + 3\text{I}_2 + 4\text{NaOH} \longrightarrow \mathbf{\text{CHI}_3 \downarrow \text{ (Yellow Precipitate)}} + \text{RCOONa} + 3\text{NaI} + 3\text{H}_2\text{O}$

                   POSITIVE vs NEGATIVE IODOFORM SUBSTRATES
                   
   POSITIVE TEST ($\text{CHI}_3 \downarrow$ Yellow Ppt):  Ethanol ($\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$), Acetaldehyde ($\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}$),
                                           Propan-2-ol, Acetone ($\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3$), Acetophenone.
   NEGATIVE TEST (No Ppt):                 Methanol ($\text{CH}_3\text{OH}$), Propan-1-ol, Formaldehyde ($\text{HCHO}$),
                                           Benzophenone, Diethyl ketone.
conceptBreakdown.content: The Iodoform Test ($\text{I}_2 / \text{NaOH}$) forms a bright yellow precipitate of $\text{CHI}_3$ (MP $119^\circ\text{C}$) with antiseptic odor for compounds with $\text{CH}_3\text{CO-}$ or $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)-}$ groups.

quickRevision: CCl₄ has zero net dipole moment (μ = 0) due to tetrahedral symmetry.
1% ethanol is added to chloroform to convert phosgene into diethyl carbonate.
Iodoform test gives yellow CHI₃ ppt for CH₃CO- and CH₃CH(OH)- compounds.
Ethanol, acetaldehyde, acetone, propan-2-ol give positive test; methanol, propan-1-ol give negative.
